summary: fetchCampaignsWithStats passed nil as the context.Context to resolveRead, causing a nil-pointer panic in store.OpenWithContext whenever stats trends, stats funnel, or stats best-time were run.
reason: resolveRead forwards its first argument to writeThroughCache, which calls store.OpenWithContext(ctx, path). database/sql.DB.conn panics when ctx is nil. The two call sites in fetchCampaignsWithStats both used the literal nil instead of context.Background(). Fixed by adding the context import and replacing nil with context.Background() at both call sites.
